HEADLINE: How Kohl's lost its way — and is trying to become relevant again

blog.headline: How Kohl’s Lost Its Way and What Founders Can Learn from It
blog.angle: Kohl’s chase for new customers fractured its core base → the tension between legacy loyalty and new appeal → the company’s repositioning efforts → founders must prioritize internal clarity over surface-level pivots.

linkedin.headline: Kohl’s spent years chasing new shoppers—and woke up to find its old ones gone.
linkedin.angle: When brands lose sight of their original customers, they risk eroding their foundation and market value.

facebook.headline: Kohl’s tried to attract new customers but ended up alienating the ones who built the brand.
facebook.angle: Kohl’s decline shows what happens when a brand loses its core audience—how can businesses balance growth with loyalty?

instagram.headline: When chasing new, you lose the old
instagram.angle: Kohl’s struggle reveals why brands must stay true to their original customers while evolving.

threads.thread_hook: Kohl’s lost relevance by forgetting who made it matter in the first place.
threads.angle: This thread breaks down how chasing new markets without internal clarity leads to brand erosion—and what founders should do instead.

stories.story_question: Is your brand losing old customers while chasing new ones?
stories.angle: Exploring the risk of alienating loyal customers during growth attempts and why internal focus matters.

images.hook_text: Navigating the currents of retail relevance.
